title: Sticker & Print Sellers: How to Photograph Flat Products That Actually Sell
description: Selling stickers, prints, or flat products online? Here's the photo approach that turns 2D items into scroll-stopping visuals.

blocks.text: Flat products—stickers, art prints, cards, laptop skins—are hard. They're 2D. They lack depth. They photograph "boring" no matter how great the design is.
Here's how to give them dimension.
The Flatness Problem
A sticker photographed on a table looks like... a sticker on a table. Zero drama. Buyers scroll past.
You need to imply usage, context, or dimensionality.
The Mockup Approach
Most sticker sellers use digital mockups—stock photos of laptops, water bottles, notebooks with the sticker composited onto them.
Problem: Everyone uses the same mockups. Buyers pattern-match "generic seller."
Better: Create your own mockups.

items.text: Take a photo of your own laptop, water bottle, or notebook
Composite your sticker design onto it

blocks.text: Now your mockups are unique. Google doesn't reverse-image them to stock libraries. Buyers subconsciously read "real brand."
The Multi-Angle Approach
For stickers and prints, shoot:

items.text: Flat on a table (main product view)
Peeled slightly to show adhesive back (proves it's real)

blocks.text: Five photos, all editing-refined via edit-photo.com.
Use Rights-Safe Source Images
Selling art prints? Your work is copyable. Watermarks feel like protection.
But: Buyers hate watermarked previews. And Amazon/Etsy prohibit watermarks on main product images.

If a source image contains a watermark, obtain an unwatermarked file from the rights holder or create your own photo. edit-photo does not remove watermarks, and removing ownership marks without permission can create legal and marketplace risks.
The Print-on-Demand Overlap
Selling prints and stickers via POD? Same rules as Blog #19—remove platform watermarks, rebrand mockups, standardize aesthetic.

The Consistency Rule
Sticker shops especially need consistent visuals. Every sticker photographed on the same surface, same crop, same lighting.
Batch through edit-photo.com for instant catalog cohesion.
The Etsy Sticker Reality

Not better designs. Better photos.
